title: UPDATE: OpenAI Adds Mobile Support and Codex Integration for Dot Agents
summary:
Users can now build "dots" agents directly from the ChatGPT applications on iOS and Android. These agents are newly capable of delegating tasks within Codex, which allows them to initiate work, track progress on existing threads, and manage "Scheduled Tasks" within the ChatGPT Work environment. The update enables the agents to utilize previous ChatGPT conversations, Codex history, and automation data to determine whether to maintain a thread or start a new one.

These features follow the debut of dots at OpenAI's DevDay event one week ago. The agents operate alongside Codex Cloud, which provide reusable development environments and a command line interface featuring voice steering and multi-agent tracking. Théo Sottiaux, head of ChatGPT and Codex, has stated that these agents are intended to become the primary interface for AI interaction to replace manual loop and graph configurations.

selectedTweets.bestBit: Your dot can now start work in Codex and follow up on existing threads, drawing on your ChatGPT conversations, Codex threads, and automations
selectedTweets.text:
Delegate work in Codex to your dot.

Your dot can now start work in Codex and follow up on existing threads, drawing on your ChatGPT conversations, Codex threads, and automations. It’s also better at deciding when to keep a thread going or start fresh.

Your dot can also review and edit Scheduled Tasks in ChatGPT Work, too. Ask what’s scheduled or update a recurring task as plans change.

selectedTweets.bestBit: One week since we launched dots!
selectedTweets.text:
One week since we launched dots! 

We’ve been working through your feedback and shipped a bunch of improvements:
- Faster cloud browsing
- Fixed extra phone notifications while you’re already using ChatGPT
- Cleaner code blocks and attachments on web
- Fewer pauses while waiting for a reply
- Faster sidebar loading, smoother animations and less loading jank
- Fixed character rendering in Safari and Firefox
- Fixed Outlook setup getting stuck
- Clearer plan guidance + a way to retry failed activity loads
- More stable safety banners on web
- Fixed clipped approval buttons and oversized Gmail previews hiding approvals
- Fixed enterprise access issues on web and when starting voice
- Better dot organization of when to use new versus existing codex threads

Up next:
- Voice reliability (being improved everyday, but we’ll shout when it’s up to par with our expectations)
- Increasing dot’s control of your Codex app: manage project folders, have full Codex thread context, rename threads, and more
- Better organization to know what your dot is working on at any given moment
- Connect your dot to multiple computers
- Better Windows support for local computer control
- what else?

Thanks for trying our product and giving us lots of feedback. Keep it coming!
